recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future work-group decision changes the workflow Event pattern or identifies a build-authoritative generated artifact that is stale despite the source being correct.
issue_request: FHIR-12634 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue for FHIR-core-_Event requesting that Event.identifier repeat so received event identifiers and local identifiers can both be retained.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite SVN #10813. The corresponding git-svn commit cdf543cd16b1724a7deb8bf1d4a7750cd13f9a03, 'Allow Event.identifier to repeat', changed source/event/event-spreadsheet.xml so Event.identifier moved from 0..1 to 0..*.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists event in the active [logical] section, so source/event/event-spreadsheet.xml remains in current build scope for the _Event logical pattern. The current Event.identifier row still has cardinality 0..* and plural business identifier wording. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches did not find a later final decision reversing or narrowing that cardinality.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were edited because the current authoritative source already satisfies the issue.
